final: SELECT inventory.store_id, AVG(grouped.payment_sum), AVG(grouped.record_count) FROM (SELECT payment.rental_id, inventory.store_id, SUM(payment.amount) AS payment_sum, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM payment JOIN rental ON rental.rental_id = payment.rental_id JOIN inventory ON inventory.inventory_id = rental.inventory_id WHERE payment.amount > 4.99 GROUP BY payment.rental_id, inventory.store_id) AS grouped GROUP BY inventory.store_id
